nodes.label: run.py
nodes.desc: kt run: resolves model, validates env vars, then either boots kt-kernel directly or builds a SGLang command that loads kt-kernel as its CPU expert backend.

nodes.label: loader.py
nodes.desc: GGUFLoader plus safetensor loader variants (FP8, BF16, Compressed, GPTQ, MXFP4, NVFP4, MXFP8); maps checkpoint tensor names to kt-kernel slots and hands raw bytes to the native side.

nodes.label: GeneralMoEWrapper
nodes.desc: Python wrapper a serving framework sees for the MoE layer; routes per-token expert choices into CPU or GPU kernels.

nodes.label: ext_bindings.cpp
nodes.desc: pybind11 module kt_kernel_ext: publishes operator classes, attaches __cpu_variant__ attributes (amx, avx512_bf16, avx512_vnni, avx2, ...) and __int8_weight_layout__ so Python picks kernels at import time.

nodes.label: common.hpp
nodes.desc: GeneralConfig / QuantConfig / GeneralMOEConfig / MLA_Config structs and the MLA_Interface, MoE_Interface, GeneralGate contracts implemented by every backend.

nodes.label: AMX_MOE_TP
nodes.desc: Tensor-parallel MoE on AMX: one instance per NUMA partition, TP_MOE gathers the partitions, load_weights stages INT4 tiles into AMX-friendly layout.

nodes.label: AMX_MOE_BASE
nodes.desc: CRTP base shared by all AMX expert variants: holds per-expert buffers, task hooks, and the shared gemm driver used by derived quant types.

nodes.label: do_gate_up_gemm
nodes.desc: Fused gate+up projection for the selected experts using AMX tile dot products, then SwiGLU activation in AVX-512 registers.

nodes.label: do_down_gemm
nodes.desc: Down-projection GEMM completing the expert FFN, accumulating into per-partition output buffers.

nodes.label: load_weights
nodes.desc: Repacks raw quantized expert bytes (with verify_load_right checks) into the TMUL tile layout AMX requires.

nodes.label: AVX2_MOE_BASE
nodes.desc: CRTP MoE base for AVX2-only hosts; mirrors the AMX contract so the same Python interface works on AMD and older Intel CPUs.

nodes.label: AVX2 load_weights
nodes.desc: Expert weight staging for the AVX2 path, including the SFT-oriented layouts used during fine-tuning.

nodes.label: amx.hpp tiles
nodes.desc: init_tile configures TMUL tile dtypes; act_fn implements SwiGLU lanes; the surrounding helpers drive ldtilecfg and tile release.

nodes.label: amx_buffers.hpp
nodes.desc: BufferA/BufferB template families: A-side activation staging with k-group variants, B-side INT4 tiles with VNNI transpose repacking.

nodes.label: KVCache
nodes.desc: Owns the paged cache: KVCacheConfig sizing, ThreadResize/BatchResize/BlockResize bookkeeping, and the attn entry the layer calls.

nodes.label: KVCacheConfig
nodes.desc: Block size, page count, dtype and sparsity knobs that decide how many blocks a retrieval step may touch.

nodes.label: attn_with_kvcache
nodes.desc: Layer-level driver that picks the layer_ or kvhead_ code path, computes block importance, and runs attention on the selected subset.

nodes.label: quantize_q_
nodes.desc: Int-quantizes queries so block similarity scores are cheap dot products instead of full-precision attention.

nodes.label: calculate_block_similarity_
nodes.desc: Scores every cached block against the quantized query to produce an importance estimate per block.

nodes.label: select_block_
nodes.desc: Keeps only the top-scoring blocks according to the configured sparsity budget.

nodes.label: retrieval_kvcache_
nodes.desc: Gathers the selected blocks' K/V pages into a compact working set for the real attention kernel.

nodes.label: calculate_sparsity_
nodes.desc: Tracks how much of the cache each step actually touched; feeds get_attn_sparsity for scheduler feedback.

nodes.label: get_attn_sparsity
nodes.desc: Public getter exposing realized sparsity so upper layers (and SGLang integration) can log or adapt budgets.

nodes.label: TaskQueue
nodes.desc: enqueue/sync primitives: expert GEMMs and block ops are pushed as jobs; sync drains the queue before results are read.

nodes.label: WorkerPool
nodes.desc: Spawns per-core threads pinned via ThreadState (alignas 64), initialized in init() with NUMA topology awareness.

nodes.label: NumaJobDistributor
nodes.desc: Splits jobs across NUMA nodes so expert partitions compute on the socket holding their weights.

nodes.label: do_work_stealing_job
nodes.desc: Balances stragglers: idle threads steal remaining job indices when the static NUMA split is uneven.

nodes.label: ThreadState
nodes.desc: Per-thread scratch (cache-aligned), core id, and node id used by every kernel to avoid false sharing.

nodes.label: binding.cpp
nodes.desc: KTransformersOps torch extension: dequant kernels for every GGUF flavor, gptq_marlin_gemm, and topk_softmax bound for Python.

nodes.label: gptq_marlin_gemm
nodes.desc: GPTQ INT4 GEMM entry: validates layouts, permutes columns, picks kernel config by SM count, and launches Marlin.

nodes.label: Marlin kernel
nodes.desc: The warp-specialized GEMM itself: global->shared staging, INT4 dequant in registers, tensor-core MMA accumulation.

nodes.label: topk_softmax
nodes.desc: Fused gating: softmax over expert logits plus top-k selection in one launch, with a workspace fallback for non-power-of-2 experts.

nodes.label: topkGatingSoftmax
nodes.desc: Warp-reduction kernel computing max/argmax and top-k in a single pass, adapted from vLLM's topk softmax kernels.
